name: cascade-harness-maintainer
description: Audits, adapts, integrates, and maintains Codex and coding-agent harness surfaces while preserving target-repository authority and delegating generic evaluation to Cascade Evals.

interface.longDescription: Audit and safely change AGENTS.md, Codex routing, skills, agent roles, configuration, hooks, tools, memory, observability, evaluation wiring, and validation surfaces in a target repository. Integrates architecture packets from Cascade Agent Architect and delegates generic evaluation mechanics to Cascade Evals.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository's Codex and agent harness for defects and duplicate authority.
Maintain this harness or integrate a reviewed agent architecture packet with the smallest validated change.
Evaluate this harness through Cascade Evals.
